summary: Practise leader responses, feedback plans and fair conflict agreements. Explore the five-day course outline and choose your next step.
lede: Leader-focused conflict resolution training helps supervisors, project leads and functional managers address workplace disagreements and agree on next steps. You practise spotting conflict patterns with the Thomas-Kilmann modes, checking assumptions with the Ladder of Inference, and planning structured feedback. The course also covers documenting clear agreements and recognizing when a neutral mediator may be appropriate.
audienceIntro: This foundation course suits you if your role requires you to address staff disagreements, reset working expectations or decide when a conflict needs a neutral third party.
modules: Ladder of Inference for Conflict Signals
Conflict Pattern Review and Leadership Reporting
prerequisites: Some experience leading, supervising or coordinating workplace teams will help you apply the cases. No specialist mediation qualification or coding is required, and the exercises do not require software installation.
